boundary: the SQLite C API, as host bindings hold it
title: Pointer-lifetime defects in host bindings over SQLite's C API

upstream.version: 3.53.3 amalgamation, for the host ASan arm

note: The defects are in the bindings, not in the engine. SQLite's own engine-internal CVEs are recorded as out of scope in row12's PROVENANCE.md. The Capstone column is measured on 7 of the 19 rows.

cheribsd.not_run: not run anywhere. The cases are defects in SQLite's foreign-language bindings, so a case is a program in that language; none of the three arms has a runtime for one. The corpus is a provenance ledger here, not an executable corpus.
